description: Couple the canonical Maintenance Room flood to bounded warning, inspection, repair, and death prose without creating a parallel hazard controller

replacements.old:
<COND (.HERE?
		     <JIGS-UP
"I'm afraid you have done drowned yourself.">)>)

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE LEAK-FUNCTION ()
	<COND (<G? ,WATER-LEVEL 0>
	       <COND (<VERB? EXAMINE LOOK-INSIDE>
		      <CORPUS-MAINT-FLOOD-EXAMINE>)
		     (<AND <VERB? PUT PUT-ON>
			   <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,PUTTY>>
		      <FIX-MAINT-LEAK>)
		     (<VERB? PLUG>
		      <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,PUTTY>
			     <FIX-MAINT-LEAK>)
			    (T <WITH-TELL ,PRSI>)>)>)>>

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE FIX-MAINT-LEAK ()
	 <SETG WATER-LEVEL -1>
	 <QUEUE I-MAINT-ROOM 0>
	 <TELL
"By some miracle of Zorkian technology, you have managed to stop the
leak in the dam." CR>>
